caseName: Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Co. v. Fuller
caseNameFull: Missouri, Kansas and Texas Railway Company v. Fuller, Assigner
summary: Error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. George P. B. Jaokson and Mr. James Hagerman for the plaintiff in error., Mr. Harrison 0. Shepard for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Judgment affirmed with *708costs by a divided court arid cause remanded to the United States Court in the Indian Territory.

Mr. George P. B. Jaokson and Mr. James Hagerman for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Harrison 0. Shepard for the defendant in error.
